zero_omission_notes.summary: Covers measures of central tendency for grouped data: Mean (Direct, Assumed Mean, Step-Deviation methods), Mode, Median, and empirical relation 3 Median = Mode + 2 Mean.

detailed_sections.full_explanation: Direct: x̄ = Σfi xi / Σfi. Assumed Mean: x̄ = a + (Σfi di / Σfi). Step-Deviation: x̄ = a + [Σfi ui / Σfi] * h where ui = (xi - a)/h.

detailed_sections.section_number_and_title: 13.2 Mode and Median of Grouped Data
detailed_sections.full_explanation: Mode = l + [(f1 - f0)/(2f1 - f0 - f2)] * h. Median = l + [(n/2 - cf)/f] * h. Empirical formula: 3 Median = Mode + 2 Mean.

practical_lab_activity_or_methodology_ma.aim_or_objective: Calculate Mode of grouped frequency distribution.
procedure_or_steps: Identify modal class with maximum frequency f1
Extract lower limit l, f0 (preceding), f2 (succeeding), and class width h
practical_lab_activity_or_methodology_ma.conclusion_or_principle: Modal value lies strictly inside modal class interval.

diagrams_figures_and_maps.drawing_or_reading_instructions: Draw histogram bars proportional to class frequencies.

common_misconceptions_and_pitfalls.common_error_or_misconception: Using cf of median class instead of preceding class in median formula.
common_misconceptions_and_pitfalls.correct_fact_or_method: cf in median formula ALWAYS comes from the class preceding the median class.
